primary_sources.title: Ctrl-A: Control-Driven Online Data Augmentation
primary_sources.read_scope: Abstract, sections3.2-3.5, especially Eq2 and validation-role paragraph
primary_sources.factual_summary: Uses augmented/clean validation accuracy ratios per operation, together with training/validation loss feedback, to adapt augmentation-strength distributions. Deliberately measures responses on validation rather than training images.
primary_sources.difference: This is a frozen training-image audit with no controller or strength optimization. Our all-correct training probe does not establish a defect in Ctrl-A; continuous margin logging alone does not establish novelty.

primary_sources.title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
primary_sources.factual_summary: Partial augmentation of two pretrained EfficientNets is compared using AUC and ECE; RandAugment can move those metrics differently.
primary_sources.difference: Current 37-class fixed-image probability responses are not calibration assessment or independent training evidence.

primary_sources.title: Understanding the Detrimental Class-level Effects of Data Augmentation
primary_sources.read_scope: Rechecked sections6-7; previous phase read sections1,5-6
primary_sources.factual_summary: Fine-grained class confusions and class-conditional interventions are existing prior work.
primary_sources.difference: We have no operator-causal or class-conditional intervention, no new semantic-loss mechanism.

primary_sources.title: Affinity and Diversity: Quantifying Mechanisms of Data Augmentation
primary_sources.factual_summary: Defines model-relative augmentation shift via clean versus augmented validation accuracy and studies its joint role with diversity.
primary_sources.difference: Our paired training-view scores are an implementation-grounded observation, not a new sensitivity principle.
